purpose: development only; final evaluation groups unavailable

fused_baseline.micro_batch: largest fitting among 4,2,1, selected by separate two-update capacity canaries

eight_bit_arms.micro_batch: same capacity-selection rule as fused baseline

quality_target: 0.95 times the initial validation NLL on the same development rows
clock: sum native e2e training-step and validation durations; setup reported separately
equal_budget_quality: last completed validation at or before the minimum final measured training-plus-validation time across all arms/seeds; no interpolation/extrapolation
statistics: 95% paired t interval across seed means; no final release claim on reused development groups
precision_exception_rationale: FP32 states for small norm tensors cost little memory; no changed weight storage or invented master copies
stop_conditions: OOM or correctness failure: stop dependent comparisons, fix and reassess
do not exceed three new one-hour allocations or overall eight GPU-hour budget
never reinterpret reused groups as final test data
capacity_selection: Before substantive training, try descending microbatches 4,2,1 separately for each arm; retain OOM failures, abort on other failures. Same effective batch 4 and model/data/precision. Freeze chosen batches across seeds; never select using quality outcomes.
